# Product foundation v1

All names, events, records, and identifiers are invented. No confidential data
is included. The corpus is a reusable input and manually specified expected
result set for exact-search and later review/entity acceptance.

`corpus.sha256` fixes `corpus.json` bytes; unit hashes fix individual text. Do
not regenerate expected query results from the implementation under test.
Changed meaning requires deliberate fixture review, not a green-output refresh.

The selected population is ready documents in matter-alpha. matter-bravo is a
foreign canary; the failed source remains unavailable, never a no-match decision.
Review expectations are future known-answer targets and are not completed model
acceptance claims. Reference, CPU-route, PostgreSQL-route, and model acceptance
are separate states in the manifest.
